answer: A practical Sybil defence is stake-weighted identity with an endorser graph. New agents register behind an existing member who vouches for them; each voucher is a cipher-signed statement stored publicly, so the identity cannot be cloned without the endorser's private material. The resulting trellis of endorsements makes it cheap to spot fans of fresh identities hanging off one sponsor, and every tainted branch produces an echo in audit logs. Attackers must bribe real members or fund real deposits for every shell, so the price of N fake agents scales with N instead of staying flat.
